visual_identity.core_identity: A squat winged stone predator disguised as architectural sculpture until it begins to move.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad crouched humanoid body, folded batlike wings, horned head, clawed hands and feet, heavy stone posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Grotesque stone face with short horns, heavy brow, broad nose, fanged mouth, no soft flesh details.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact muscular humanoid carved from stone, thick forearms, bent legs, folded wings.
visual_identity.surface: Stone planes with a few cracks and chipped edges, not dense masonry texture.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly two clawed arms and two clawed bipedal legs form the humanoid stone body, plus one pair of folded batlike wings attached to the back. No extra arms, dragon quadruped limbs, or feathered wings.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one squat stone humanoid with exactly two arms, two bent legs, one horned grotesque head, and one pair of folded batlike wings attached behind the shoulders/back. Keep the body compact and crouched like architectural sculpture, not a four-legged dragon.

accuracy_checks: reads as stone sculpture becoming alive
transition from still sculpture to movement is readable
environment remains secondary to the gargoyle

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

physical_requirements: ground_support: resting sculpture disguise requires a believable load-bearing support; environment engine chooses the ledge, plinth, roof, gate, wall projection, rock, or other compatible structure
description: A squat winged stone predator disguised as architectural sculpture until it begins to move. Compact muscular humanoid carved from stone, thick forearms, bent legs, folded wings. Stone planes with a few cracks and chipped edges, not dense masonry texture.

scene_identity.size_impression: Medium squat stone humanoid predator whose mass reads architectural and heavy, not dragon-sized.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Clawed feet and hands brace against stone support; folded wings stay attached to the back without hiding the humanoid stone body.

known_failure_modes.symptom: stone creature becomes quadrupedal or dragon-bodied
known_failure_modes.correction: restore two arms, two bipedal legs, one humanoid torso, horned grotesque head, and one folded wing pair

known_failure_modes.symptom: face/body becomes smooth human or feather-winged angelic
known_failure_modes.correction: restore grotesque stone face, claws, batlike wings, and chipped stone planes
